assets_dimensions_positive.name: assets_dimensions_positive
assets_dimensions_positive.value: ("assets"."width" is null or "assets"."width" > 0) and ("assets"."height" is null or "assets"."height" > 0)

jobs_failed_has_error.name: jobs_failed_has_error
jobs_failed_has_error.value: "jobs"."status" <> 'failed' or ("jobs"."error_code" is not null and "jobs"."error_message" is not null)

jobs_target_matches_type.name: jobs_target_matches_type
jobs_target_matches_type.value: ("jobs"."type" = 'generate_brief' and "jobs"."campaign_id" is not null) or ("jobs"."type" = 'regenerate_section' and "jobs"."draft_id" is not null) or ("jobs"."type" = 'export_package' and "jobs"."draft_id" is not null)

usage_events_amounts_check.name: usage_events_amounts_check
usage_events_amounts_check.value: "usage_events"."requests" >= 0 and "usage_events"."input_units" >= 0 and "usage_events"."output_units" >= 0 and "usage_events"."reserved_usd" >= 0 and ("usage_events"."cost_usd" is null or "usage_events"."cost_usd" >= 0)

usage_events_settled_check.name: usage_events_settled_check
usage_events_settled_check.value: ("usage_events"."status" = 'reserved' and "usage_events"."settled_at" is null) or ("usage_events"."status" <> 'reserved' and "usage_events"."settled_at" is not null)
